title: Exclusive: Amazon’s Zoox more than doubles its robotaxi footprint in Bay Area city
key_facts: Zoox, Amazon's robotaxi company, has leased two industrial buildings of more than 350,000 square feet at 25500 Clawiter Road in Hayward, California, the Chronicle has learned.
They sit near Zoox's existing 220,000-square-foot factory, which can assemble up to 10,000 robotaxis a year, the company confirmed.
Real estate firm JLL announced the deal but did not name the tenant; Hayward has issued Zoox a business licence for the warehouses.
A Zoox spokesperson said the space is for scaling its purpose-built robotaxi fleet but declined to give specifics.
Zoox robotaxis carry passengers in San Francisco and Las Vegas; they have seats facing each other and no steering wheel or pedals.
